text: The following question stood in the name of  Dr Tan Wu Meng –   14 To ask the Minister for National Development in the past two years (a) how many incidents of pet abductions have been reported; (b) what proportion of these cases have had the pets rescued and returned to their owners well and unharmed; and (c) what is the approach when alleged abductions of community cats, which do not have specific named owners but are well-known in the local community, are reported.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Mr Tan Kiat How) (for the Minister for National Development)
text: But he texted me to remind me that this question is on behalf of his Clementi residents.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Mr Tan Kiat How) (for the Minister for National Development)
text: There could be various reasons for a community cat going missing.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Mr Tan Kiat How) (for the Minister for National Development)
text: This includes encouraging responsible pet ownership and community caregiving, as well as the rehoming of suitable animals.

speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang
text: I am asking this on behalf of Dr Tan Wu Meng and, of course, on behalf of his Clementi residents also.
